items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: In the Basie format ... are used quite a bit, especially in the modern era with Ernie Wilkins, Quincy Jones, Oliver Nelson, and Neil Hefti

ctx.x: Do you remember when -- oh, the point about like achieving status or tenure in the band. How did one do that, or how did one know that one was there?

This band had a good record of longevity. The people that joined the band generally stayed in the band for years. I was there 11 years. Benny Powell was there a good ten or 12 years. No, I think Benny Powell was there about ten years. Joe Newman was there forever. He was there at least ten years. Henry Coker was there for almost the same length of time. There was only one or two chairs that had quick turnovers. One was that tenor chair, the other tenor saxophone chair that was ultimately occupied by Eddie…
